cohort: The study participants were 60 parturients scheduled for elective lower segment caesarean section (LSCS) under spinal anesthesia.
finding: Prophylactic intravenous Glycopyrrolate significantly reduced the incidence and severity of hypotension and the need for vasopressors during spinal anesthesia for caesarean section compared to saline.
mod_finding: For parturients undergoing caesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia, prophylactic Glycopyrrolate significantly reduced hypotension and vasopressor requirements.
